intro.text: The leader of the opposition on Bilming's council.

items.text: Besides leading Bilming's opposition, Pielle acted as a local adviser to the Elendel Senate. The Set kidnapped him and held him with other political dissidents in caverns beneath Bilming, where they ran experiments on the prisoners. He was deeply grateful when Marasi and her companions found them.

appearance.text: Dresses for business; his head is largely bald, with only scattered tufts of hair.
